Check new reproduction retail (eBay BIN, Amazon AU 'pickelhaube replica').
viewing_check: Inside the shell and under the liner: look for maker or date stamps, inspector marks and unit stamps (e.g. regiment and year on the leather or liner), sewn/stitched vs glued liner, spike base and eagle plate construction (stamped thin brass vs cast), age of leather (cracking, crazing) versus glossy modern paint, rosette and chinstrap age, and whether fittings are magnetic/zinc. Photograph the inside crown and any stamps.
rate_note: Database prices are AUD hammer, rate 1. Reproduction-described Noble lots (2017) hammered $220-340; originals $270-1,000. Blind view: likely reproduction, realistic range roughly $60-150 unless stamps show it is original.
